title: dactylorhiza × surensis
intro: Dactylorhiza × surensis, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid or Surensis orchid, is a naturally occurring hybrid of two orchid species. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dactylorhiza × surensis include its potential to aid in diabetes management, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
